{"messages":[{"content":"Task: Build the Q1 2026 board deck: KPI tiles, budget-versus-actuals lines, flux commentary and FY2025 comparatives, then propose publishing it.

Required outputs (artifact names are fixed; produce each exactly once):
Documents to read first (these ids exist; nothing else does):
  `materiality_memo`, `credit_agreement`, `fy2026_budget`, `fy2025_monthly_summary`, `bank_statement_2026_03`, `payroll_tax_2026`

Artifacts produced by earlier runs that already exist as of your pin. Use them directly by name as emit_number inputs, artifact_ids or supporters; they need no read and no search:
  `q1_revenue_total`, `q1_ebitda`, `q1_membership_revenue`, `ttm_adj_ebitda_2026_q1`, `q1_route_setting_expense`, `q1_utilities_expense`, `q1_legal_expense`, `q1_payroll_tax_expense`, `uc_sierra_progress_pct`, `q1_wallbuild_revenue`

Required outputs, in order (use these exact names, formulas and inputs; inputs refer to claims you will have read, by their document/line item/entity/period, or to artifacts you produced):
- emit_number `tile_q1_revenue` (line_item revenue, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: Q1 revenue ($0.1M). Formula: `x` with x = artifact `q1_revenue_total`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 100000}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_ebitda` (line_item ebitda, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: Q1 EBITDA ($0.1M). Formula: `x` with x = artifact `q1_ebitda`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 100000}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_ebitda_margin` (line_item margin, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: EBITDA margin %. Formula: `e/r*100` with e = artifact `q1_ebitda`; r = artifact `q1_revenue_total`. Conclusions: {'display_decimals': 1}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_membership_revenue` (line_item membership_revenue, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: membership revenue ($0.01M). Formula: `x` with x = artifact `q1_membership_revenue`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 10000}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_cash_collected` (line_item cash_kpi, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: Q1 cash collected. Formula: `x` with x = claim 'cash_collected' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `bank_statement_2026_03`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 100000}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_net_leverage` (line_item leverage, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: net leverage vs 3.00x covenant. Formula: `(loan-cash)/ttm` with loan = claim 'term_loan_principal' in document `credit_agreement`; cash = claim 'cash_balance' 2026-03-31 in document `bank_statement_2026_03`; ttm = artifact `ttm_adj_ebitda_2026_q1`. Conclusions: {'covenant_max': 3.0}.
- emit_number `kpi_q1_revenue_growth_yoy` (line_item growth, period 2026-Q1): Q1 revenue growth vs Q1 2025, %. Formula: `(r-p)/p*100` with r = artifact `q1_revenue_total`; p = claim 'revenue' 2025-01-01..2025-03-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`. Conclusions: {'sign': 'up'}.
- emit_number `kpi_q1_route_setting_qoq` (line_item route_setting_growth, period 2026-Q1): Route-setting cost change vs Q4 2025, %. Formula: `(q-p)/p*100` with q = artifact `q1_route_setting_expense`; p = claim 'route_setting' 2025-10-01..2025-12-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`. Conclusions: {'sign': 'down', 'display_decimals': 0}.
- emit_number `bva_q1_revenue` (line_item bva_revenue, period 2026-Q1): BvA: revenue vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_revenue_total`; b = claim 'budget_revenue' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_membership` (line_item bva_membership, period 2026-Q1): BvA: membership revenue vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_membership_revenue`; b = claim 'budget_membership_revenue' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_utilities` (line_item bva_utilities, period 2026-Q1): BvA: utilities vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_utilities_expense`; b = claim 'budget_utilities' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_route_setting` (line_item bva_route_setting, period 2026-Q1): BvA: route setting vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_route_setting_expense`; b = claim 'budget_route_setting' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_legal` (line_item bva_legal, period 2026-Q1): BvA: legal vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_legal_expense`; b = claim 'budget_legal' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_payroll_tax` (line_item bva_payroll_tax, period 2026-Q1): BvA: payroll tax vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_payroll_tax_expense`; b = claim 'budget_payroll_tax' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_ebitda` (line_item bva_ebitda, period 2026-Q1): BvA: EBITDA vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_ebitda`; b = claim 'budget_ebitda' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `comp_fy2025_revenue` (line_item revenue, period 2025): Comparative: FY2025 revenue. Formula: `x` with x = claim 'revenue' 2025-01-01..2025-12-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 100000}.
- emit_number `comp_fy2025_ebitda` (line_item ebitda, period 2025): Comparative: FY2025 EBITDA. Formula: `x` with x = claim 'ebitda' 2025-01-01..2025-12-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 10000}.
- emit_number `kpi_fy2025_ebitda_margin` (line_item margin, period 2025): Comparative: FY2025 EBITDA margin %. Formula: `e/r*100` with e = artifact `comp_fy2025_ebitda`; r = artifact `comp_fy2025_revenue`. Conclusions: {'display_decimals': 1}.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_revenue_growth` (line_item revenue, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Q1 revenue grew year over year, led by memberships."; claim_ids: claim 'revenue' 2025-01-01..2025-03-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`; artifact_ids: `q1_revenue_total`, `kpi_q1_revenue_growth_yoy`. Conclusions: {'sign': 'up'}.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_membership_flux` (line_item membership_revenue, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Membership revenue was $7.42M in Q1, 0.9% above the $7.35M budget, reflecting the February migration to annual prepaid plans."; claim_ids: claim 'budget_membership_revenue' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`; artifact_ids: `tile_q1_membership_revenue`, `bva_q1_membership`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_route_setting` (line_item route_setting, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Route-setting costs fell 18% quarter over quarter as the in-house crew replaced contractors."; claim_ids: claim 'route_setting' 2025-10-01..2025-12-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`; artifact_ids: `kpi_q1_route_setting_qoq`, `q1_route_setting_expense`. Conclusions: {'sign': 'down'}.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_utilities` (line_item utilities, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Utilities ran 2% over budget on winter rates at Sacramento."; claim_ids: claim 'budget_utilities' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`; artifact_ids: `bva_q1_utilities`, `q1_utilities_expense`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_wallbuild` (line_item wallbuild_revenue, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Wall Build is 40% complete on UC Sierra with $360,000 recognized in Q1."; claim_ids: none; artifact_ids: `uc_sierra_progress_pct`, `q1_wallbuild_revenue`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_ebitda_margin` (line_item margin, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "EBITDA margin was 13.4%, 90 bps below the 14.3% full-year budget run-rate."; claim_ids: claim 'budget_ebitda' 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 in document `fy2026_budget`; claim 'budget_revenue' 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 in document `fy2026_budget`; artifact_ids: `tile_q1_ebitda_margin`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_covenant` (line_item leverage, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Net leverage was 2.95x against the 3.00x covenant, with about $100k of EBITDA headroom."; claim_ids: claim 'covenant_max_leverage' in document `credit_agreement`; artifact_ids: `tile_q1_net_leverage`. Conclusions: {'covenant_max': 3.0}.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_cash` (line_item cash_kpi, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Cash collections were $9.9M in Q1, 95% of billings, and cash closed at $1.5M."; claim_ids: claim 'cash_balance' 2026-03-31 in document `bank_statement_2026_03`; artifact_ids: `tile_q1_cash_collected`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_fy2025_comp` (line_item ebitda, period 2025): text_request: "FY2025 revenue was $39.1M with EBITDA of $5.55M (14.2% margin), the comparative base for 2026."; claim_ids: none; artifact_ids: `comp_fy2025_revenue`, `comp_fy2025_ebitda`, `kpi_fy2025_ebitda_margin`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_payroll_tax` (line_item payroll_tax, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Payroll taxes were 5% under budget in Q1 at the 3.4% UI rate."; claim_ids: claim 'sui_rate' 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 in document `payroll_tax_2026`; artifact_ids: `bva_q1_payroll_tax`.
- propose_action `deck_publish_q1_2026` (kind deck_publish, approver_role controller, period 2026-Q1, line_item deck): params {'summary': 'Q1 2026 board deck published to the board portal', 'recipients': 'Board of Directors'}; supporters: artifact `tile_q1_revenue`, artifact `tile_q1_ebitda`, artifact `tile_q1_ebitda_margin`, artifact `tile_q1_membership_revenue`, artifact `tile_q1_cash_collected`, artifact `tile_q1_net_leverage`, artifact `deck_s_revenue_growth`, artifact `deck_s_membership_flux`, artifact `deck_s_route_setting`, artifact `deck_s_utilities`, artifact `deck_s_wallbuild`, artifact `deck_s_ebitda_margin`, artifact `deck_s_covenant`, artifact `deck_s_cash`, artifact `deck_s_fy2025_comp`, artifact `deck_s_payroll_tax`.

{"messages":[{"content":"Task: Build the Q1 2026 board deck: KPI tiles, budget-versus-actuals lines, flux commentary and FY2025 comparatives, then propose publishing it.

Required outputs (artifact names are fixed; produce each exactly once):
Documents to read first (these ids exist; nothing else does):
  `materiality_memo`, `credit_agreement`, `fy2026_budget`, `fy2025_monthly_summary`, `bank_statement_2026_03`, `payroll_tax_2026`

Artifacts produced by earlier runs that already exist as of your pin. Use them directly by name as emit_number inputs, artifact_ids or supporters; they need no read and no search:
  `q1_revenue_total`, `q1_ebitda`, `q1_membership_revenue`, `ttm_adj_ebitda_2026_q1`, `q1_route_setting_expense`, `q1_utilities_expense`, `q1_legal_expense`, `q1_payroll_tax_expense`, `uc_sierra_progress_pct`, `q1_wallbuild_revenue`

Required outputs, in order (use these exact names, formulas and inputs; inputs refer to claims you will have read, by their document/line item/entity/period, or to artifacts you produced):
- emit_number `tile_q1_revenue` (line_item revenue, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: Q1 revenue ($0.1M). Formula: `x` with x = artifact `q1_revenue_total`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 100000}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_ebitda` (line_item ebitda, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: Q1 EBITDA ($0.1M). Formula: `x` with x = artifact `q1_ebitda`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 100000}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_ebitda_margin` (line_item margin, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: EBITDA margin %. Formula: `e/r*100` with e = artifact `q1_ebitda`; r = artifact `q1_revenue_total`. Conclusions: {'display_decimals': 1}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_membership_revenue` (line_item membership_revenue, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: membership revenue ($0.01M). Formula: `x` with x = artifact `q1_membership_revenue`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 10000}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_cash_collected` (line_item cash_kpi, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: Q1 cash collected. Formula: `x` with x = claim 'cash_collected' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `bank_statement_2026_03`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 100000}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_net_leverage` (line_item leverage, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: net leverage vs 3.00x covenant. Formula: `(loan-cash)/ttm` with loan = claim 'term_loan_principal' in document `credit_agreement`; cash = claim 'cash_balance' 2026-03-31 in document `bank_statement_2026_03`; ttm = artifact `ttm_adj_ebitda_2026_q1`. Conclusions: {'covenant_max': 3.0}.
- emit_number `kpi_q1_revenue_growth_yoy` (line_item growth, period 2026-Q1): Q1 revenue growth vs Q1 2025, %. Formula: `(r-p)/p*100` with r = artifact `q1_revenue_total`; p = claim 'revenue' 2025-01-01..2025-03-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`. Conclusions: {'sign': 'up'}.
- emit_number `kpi_q1_route_setting_qoq` (line_item route_setting_growth, period 2026-Q1): Route-setting cost change vs Q4 2025, %. Formula: `(q-p)/p*100` with q = artifact `q1_route_setting_expense`; p = claim 'route_setting' 2025-10-01..2025-12-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`. Conclusions: {'sign': 'down', 'display_decimals': 0}.
- emit_number `bva_q1_revenue` (line_item bva_revenue, period 2026-Q1): BvA: revenue vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_revenue_total`; b = claim 'budget_revenue' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_membership` (line_item bva_membership, period 2026-Q1): BvA: membership revenue vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_membership_revenue`; b = claim 'budget_membership_revenue' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_utilities` (line_item bva_utilities, period 2026-Q1): BvA: utilities vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_utilities_expense`; b = claim 'budget_utilities' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_route_setting` (line_item bva_route_setting, period 2026-Q1): BvA: route setting vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_route_setting_expense`; b = claim 'budget_route_setting' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_legal` (line_item bva_legal, period 2026-Q1): BvA: legal vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_legal_expense`; b = claim 'budget_legal' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_payroll_tax` (line_item bva_payroll_tax, period 2026-Q1): BvA: payroll tax vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_payroll_tax_expense`; b = claim 'budget_payroll_tax' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_ebitda` (line_item bva_ebitda, period 2026-Q1): BvA: EBITDA vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_ebitda`; b = claim 'budget_ebitda' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `comp_fy2025_revenue` (line_item revenue, period 2025): Comparative: FY2025 revenue. Formula: `x` with x = claim 'revenue' 2025-01-01..2025-12-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 100000}.
- emit_number `comp_fy2025_ebitda` (line_item ebitda, period 2025): Comparative: FY2025 EBITDA. Formula: `x` with x = claim 'ebitda' 2025-01-01..2025-12-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 10000}.
- emit_number `kpi_fy2025_ebitda_margin` (line_item margin, period 2025): Comparative: FY2025 EBITDA margin %. Formula: `e/r*100` with e = artifact `comp_fy2025_ebitda`; r = artifact `comp_fy2025_revenue`. Conclusions: {'display_decimals': 1}.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_revenue_growth` (line_item revenue, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Q1 revenue grew year over year, led by memberships."; claim_ids: claim 'revenue' 2025-01-01..2025-03-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`; artifact_ids: `q1_revenue_total`, `kpi_q1_revenue_growth_yoy`. Conclusions: {'sign': 'up'}.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_membership_flux` (line_item membership_revenue, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Membership revenue was $7.42M in Q1, 0.9% above the $7.35M budget, reflecting the February migration to annual prepaid plans."; claim_ids: claim 'budget_membership_revenue' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`; artifact_ids: `tile_q1_membership_revenue`, `bva_q1_membership`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_route_setting` (line_item route_setting, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Route-setting costs fell 18% quarter over quarter as the in-house crew replaced contractors."; claim_ids: claim 'route_setting' 2025-10-01..2025-12-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`; artifact_ids: `kpi_q1_route_setting_qoq`, `q1_route_setting_expense`. Conclusions: {'sign': 'down'}.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_utilities` (line_item utilities, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Utilities ran 2% over budget on winter rates at Sacramento."; claim_ids: claim 'budget_utilities' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`; artifact_ids: `bva_q1_utilities`, `q1_utilities_expense`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_wallbuild` (line_item wallbuild_revenue, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Wall Build is 40% complete on UC Sierra with $360,000 recognized in Q1."; claim_ids: none; artifact_ids: `uc_sierra_progress_pct`, `q1_wallbuild_revenue`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_ebitda_margin` (line_item margin, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "EBITDA margin was 13.4%, 90 bps below the 14.3% full-year budget run-rate."; claim_ids: claim 'budget_ebitda' 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 in document `fy2026_budget`; claim 'budget_revenue' 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 in document `fy2026_budget`; artifact_ids: `tile_q1_ebitda_margin`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_covenant` (line_item leverage, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Net leverage was 2.95x against the 3.00x covenant, with about $100k of EBITDA headroom."; claim_ids: claim 'covenant_max_leverage' in document `credit_agreement`; artifact_ids: `tile_q1_net_leverage`. Conclusions: {'covenant_max': 3.0}.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_cash` (line_item cash_kpi, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Cash collections were $9.9M in Q1, 95% of billings, and cash closed at $1.5M."; claim_ids: claim 'cash_balance' 2026-03-31 in document `bank_statement_2026_03`; artifact_ids: `tile_q1_cash_collected`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_fy2025_comp` (line_item ebitda, period 2025): text_request: "FY2025 revenue was $39.1M with EBITDA of $5.55M (14.2% margin), the comparative base for 2026."; claim_ids: none; artifact_ids: `comp_fy2025_revenue`, `comp_fy2025_ebitda`, `kpi_fy2025_ebitda_margin`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_payroll_tax` (line_item payroll_tax, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Payroll taxes were 5% under budget in Q1 at the 3.4% UI rate."; claim_ids: claim 'sui_rate' 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 in document `payroll_tax_2026`; artifact_ids: `bva_q1_payroll_tax`.
- propose_action `deck_publish_q1_2026` (kind deck_publish, approver_role controller, period 2026-Q1, line_item deck): params {'summary': 'Q1 2026 board deck published to the board portal', 'recipients': 'Board of Directors'}; supporters: artifact `tile_q1_revenue`, artifact `tile_q1_ebitda`, artifact `tile_q1_ebitda_margin`, artifact `tile_q1_membership_revenue`, artifact `tile_q1_cash_collected`, artifact `tile_q1_net_leverage`, artifact `deck_s_revenue_growth`, artifact `deck_s_membership_flux`, artifact `deck_s_route_setting`, artifact `deck_s_utilities`, artifact `deck_s_wallbuild`, artifact `deck_s_ebitda_margin`, artifact `deck_s_covenant`, artifact `deck_s_cash`, artifact `deck_s_fy2025_comp`, artifact `deck_s_payroll_tax`.

Required outputs (artifact names are fixed; produce each exactly once):
Documents to read first (these ids exist; nothing else does):
  `materiality_memo`, `credit_agreement`, `fy2026_budget`, `fy2025_monthly_summary`, `bank_statement_2026_03`, `payroll_tax_2026`

Artifacts produced by earlier runs (other agents or your own) that you build on. Read each with get_artifact first (it records what you consumed), then use it by name as an emit_number input, artifact_id or supporter:
  `q1_revenue_total`, `q1_ebitda`, `q1_membership_revenue`, `leverage_2026_q1`, `q1_route_setting_expense`, `q1_utilities_expense`, `q1_legal_expense`, `q1_payroll_tax_expense`, `uc_sierra_progress_pct`, `q1_wallbuild_revenue`, `covenant_headroom_2026_q1`

Required outputs, in order (use these exact names, formulas and inputs; inputs refer to claims you will have read, by their document/line item/entity/period, or to artifacts you produced):
- emit_number `tile_q1_revenue` (line_item revenue, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: Q1 revenue ($0.1M). Formula: `x` with x = artifact `q1_revenue_total`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 100000}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_ebitda` (line_item ebitda, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: Q1 EBITDA ($0.1M). Formula: `x` with x = artifact `q1_ebitda`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 100000}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_ebitda_margin` (line_item margin, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: EBITDA margin %. Formula: `e/r*100` with e = artifact `q1_ebitda`; r = artifact `q1_revenue_total`. Conclusions: {'display_decimals': 1}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_membership_revenue` (line_item membership_revenue, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: membership revenue ($0.01M). Formula: `x` with x = artifact `q1_membership_revenue`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 10000}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_cash_collected` (line_item cash_kpi, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: Q1 cash collected. Formula: `x` with x = claim 'cash_collected' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `bank_statement_2026_03`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 100000}.
- emit_number `tile_q1_net_leverage` (line_item leverage, period 2026-Q1): KPI tile: net leverage vs 3.00x covenant (from the Covenant agent's calculation). Formula: `lev` with lev = artifact `leverage_2026_q1`. Conclusions: {'covenant_max': 3.0}.
- emit_number `kpi_q1_revenue_growth_yoy` (line_item growth, period 2026-Q1): Q1 revenue growth vs Q1 2025, %. Formula: `(r-p)/p*100` with r = artifact `q1_revenue_total`; p = claim 'revenue' 2025-01-01..2025-03-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`. Conclusions: {'sign': 'up'}.
- emit_number `kpi_q1_route_setting_qoq` (line_item route_setting_growth, period 2026-Q1): Route-setting cost change vs Q4 2025, %. Formula: `(q-p)/p*100` with q = artifact `q1_route_setting_expense`; p = claim 'route_setting' 2025-10-01..2025-12-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`. Conclusions: {'sign': 'down', 'display_decimals': 0}.
- emit_number `bva_q1_revenue` (line_item bva_revenue, period 2026-Q1): BvA: revenue vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_revenue_total`; b = claim 'budget_revenue' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_membership` (line_item bva_membership, period 2026-Q1): BvA: membership revenue vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_membership_revenue`; b = claim 'budget_membership_revenue' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_utilities` (line_item bva_utilities, period 2026-Q1): BvA: utilities vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_utilities_expense`; b = claim 'budget_utilities' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_route_setting` (line_item bva_route_setting, period 2026-Q1): BvA: route setting vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_route_setting_expense`; b = claim 'budget_route_setting' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_legal` (line_item bva_legal, period 2026-Q1): BvA: legal vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_legal_expense`; b = claim 'budget_legal' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_payroll_tax` (line_item bva_payroll_tax, period 2026-Q1): BvA: payroll tax vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_payroll_tax_expense`; b = claim 'budget_payroll_tax' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `bva_q1_ebitda` (line_item bva_ebitda, period 2026-Q1): BvA: EBITDA vs budget. Formula: `a-b` with a = artifact `q1_ebitda`; b = claim 'budget_ebitda' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`.
- emit_number `comp_fy2025_revenue` (line_item revenue, period 2025): Comparative: FY2025 revenue. Formula: `x` with x = claim 'revenue' 2025-01-01..2025-12-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 100000}.
- emit_number `comp_fy2025_ebitda` (line_item ebitda, period 2025): Comparative: FY2025 EBITDA. Formula: `x` with x = claim 'ebitda' 2025-01-01..2025-12-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`. Conclusions: {'display_rounding': 10000}.
- emit_number `kpi_fy2025_ebitda_margin` (line_item margin, period 2025): Comparative: FY2025 EBITDA margin %. Formula: `e/r*100` with e = artifact `comp_fy2025_ebitda`; r = artifact `comp_fy2025_revenue`. Conclusions: {'display_decimals': 1}.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_revenue_growth` (line_item revenue, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Q1 revenue grew year over year, led by memberships."; claim_ids: claim 'revenue' 2025-01-01..2025-03-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`; artifact_ids: `q1_revenue_total`, `kpi_q1_revenue_growth_yoy`. - emit_sentence `deck_s_membership_flux` (line_item membership_revenue, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Membership revenue was $7.42M in Q1, 0.9% above the $7.35M budget, reflecting the February migration to annual prepaid plans."; claim_ids: claim 'budget_membership_revenue' 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 in document `fy2026_budget`; artifact_ids: `tile_q1_membership_revenue`, `bva_q1_membership`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_route_setting` (line_item route_setting, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Route-setting costs fell 18% quarter over quarter as the in-house crew replaced contractors."; claim_ids: claim 'route_setting' 2025-10-01..2025-12-31 in document `fy2025_monthly_summary`; artifact_ids: `kpi_q1_route_setting_qoq`, `q1_route_setting_expense`. - emit_sentence `deck_s_wallbuild` (line_item wallbuild_revenue, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Wall Build is 40% complete on UC Sierra with $360,000 recognized in Q1."; claim_ids: none; artifact_ids: `uc_sierra_progress_pct`, `q1_wallbuild_revenue`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_ebitda_margin` (line_item margin, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "EBITDA margin was 13.4%, 90 bps below the 14.3% full-year budget run-rate."; claim_ids: claim 'budget_ebitda' 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 in document `fy2026_budget`; claim 'budget_revenue' 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 in document `fy2026_budget`; artifact_ids: `tile_q1_ebitda_margin`.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_covenant` (line_item leverage, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "We remain within our 3.00x covenant: net leverage was 2.95x, with about $100k of EBITDA headroom."; claim_ids: claim 'covenant_max_leverage' in document `credit_agreement`; artifact_ids: `tile_q1_net_leverage`, `covenant_headroom_2026_q1`. Conclusions: {'covenant_max': 3.0}.
- emit_sentence `deck_s_cash` (line_item cash_kpi, period 2026-Q1): text_request: "Cash collections were $9.9M in Q1, 95% of billings, and cash closed at $1.5M."; claim_ids: claim 'cash_balance' 2026-03-31 in document `bank_statement_2026_03`; artifact_ids: `tile_q1_cash_collected`.
